strings: r_c0 is surprised to find m_c coming to talk to {PRONOUN/r_c0/object}. Slowly m_c explains that {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/think/thinks} that cats of the dark forest are trying to drag {PRONOUN/m_c/object} there.
In the early hours of the morning poor m_c finds {PRONOUN/m_c/self} frozen, feeling like a creature is crawling all over {PRONOUN/m_c/object} that {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} can't quite see.
